versions.changelog: Security hardening: added data-handling/external-transmission warnings, upload privacy notice, publish-disclosure warning, and removed all delete endpoints to prevent automated data loss

Major update: added 7 new API endpoints (search, uploads, plots, catalog, jobs, usage, knowledge base), expanded data sources (Eurostat, NZ Health, GBIF, GADM, Pathoplexus, OpenAlex, PubMed, Zotero, expanded Mosqlimate/PAHO/ECDC/HealthData.gov), added OAuth auth, updated WebSocket protocol with tool/job events and clarifications, fixed homepage URL and emoji, removed deployment section

Complete rewrite: removed Python helper script (replaced by pure API reference). Added endpoints for plots (list, search, download image, download code, ZIP), reports (list, download PDF/MD), code snippets (search via /search endpoint), and My Data (list, upload, preview). Documented auth: X-API-Key for most endpoints, Bearer for plot file downloads.

- Adds guidance on expected response times for EpidBot queries (30 seconds to 5 minutes depending on complexity).
- Recommends and documents exponential backoff polling for asynchronous chat jobs, replacing previous fixed-interval polling.
- Updates usage examples to demonstrate exponential backoff in polling logic.
- Clarifies that complex queries involving large data analysis may require up to 5 minutes.
Fixed: duplicate user_id argument caused 500 error on POST /chat
Async chat API: submit+poll pattern replaces sync endpoint. No more timeout issues.
